sourceAssessment.assessment: Scan/Stop now has content-driven width and height with 48dp minimums; FlowRow permits the adjacent status to wrap. The original start/stop callbacks and full labels are unchanged. No max height or font-scale override was added. Actual 1.0x/1.5x fit, touch size and one-action behavior remain unobserved.

Generic headlines use the rounded 600/ROND=100 family. The top-bar helper supplies the separate 900/112.5/35 face and 32sp/32sp style to actual title text. The original font asset and role ss02/dlig settings remain. This matches the approved source mapping, not a rendered font/fallback match.

Navigation label sizing and ring geometry use defaultSpatialSpec; destination/status fades use defaultEffectsSpec. Icon Crossfade, circle toggle shapes, 16dp stroke and 8dp gap remain. Connection motion is an approved functional adaptation. No custom clock or system-scale bypass is introduced.
Stateful segmented-list shape parity remains open; neither Shape.kt nor dependency pins changed.
